issues.description: The record appears to combine headline maxima (VOC up to 1.29 V, FF above 80%, JSC up to 17 mA cm−2) into one cell. The paper does not establish that all maxima belong to the same measured device.
issues.suggested_value: Use one explicit JV row/scan for the cell, or represent these as separate reported maxima rather than a coherent device.
issues.source_text: The abstract reports VOC up to 1.29 V, FF above 80%, JSC up to 17 mA cm−2, and efficiencies of 17%.
